messages:
Ethan B: Short thread to capture a slightly different angle: consensus-lite for canaries. Problem: we want fast local bailouts but also an auditable promotion path that avoids global flip-flop. High-level idea: observers vote on short windows, a quorum promotes, controller mints timeboxed promotion tokens with the quorum snapshot.

Priya S: Voting is interesting. How do we avoid noisy nodes overwhelming the quorum?

Olga R: Use weighted votes based on recent reliability and tenant isolation. Example: node_score = uptime_factor * recent_error_suppression. Only nodes with node_score > threshold count toward quorum.

Ethan B: Also keep quorum scope limited to the canary cohort (pods running the variant), not the whole cluster. That keeps latency low and makes votes meaningful.

infra-bot: deploy 3730011222: canary "v3-consensus" -> 0.7% at 08:45 UTC. Monitoring hooks: latency,error,quality.

Marcus: Key transitions: SHADOW -> CANARY (requires 3-node quorum OR controller token) ; CANARY -> RAMP (requires sustained quorum for 15m + controller audit token); any observer major deviation can trigger EMERGENCY_SPILL immediately for up to 45s.

Devon: Telemetry: emit vote records with minimal footprint: {cohort_id, node_id, vote_time, vote_signal, compact_hash}. Keep content-free to avoid PII.

Priya S: Cache warming: micro-shadow 0.1% and preheat KV for top-N prefixes. Mirror should be tagged and excluded from tenant quotas.

Olga R: Fallback ladder: 1) exact prefix cache, 2) tenant-pinned variant, 3) local quantized variant, 4) hosted fallback. Router enforces tenant policy locally; policy table is periodically refreshed.

Ethan B: Split-brain: if controller unreachable, quorum-only promotions allowed but with reduced max_spill_pct and require a stronger quorum (e.g., 2x nodes). Controller reconciliation on rejoin can emit audit reasons.

Marcus: Ops snippet: EMERGENCY_SPILL -> mark cohort quarantined, scale new variant to zero, route affected tenants to pinned variants, snapshot recent traces and vote logs, page SRE with affected-tenant list.

Devon: Tests: simulate noisy-node votes, simulate controller partition and reconcilers, and verify that audit token includes vote snapshot so post-mortems can explain the decision.

Ethan B: Action items: Olga -> vote weighting sketch; Priya -> mirror filter and preheat list; Marcus -> runbook EMERGENCY_SPILL draft; Devon -> compact telemetry schema. I'll collate and add to the RFC follow-up.

Priya S: LGTM. Add chaos tests for stale-cache and heavy-tailed latencies too.

Olga R: Will do.

Ethan B: Thanks all :thumbsup:
